name: Silvanthir Moonbough
title: Warden of Roots
description: An ancient elf with bark-like skin and eyes the color of spring leaves. Silvanthir tends the enchanted trees that serve as living vaults, speaking to them in the old tongue.

greeting.first_time: Peace upon you, wanderer. I am Silvanthir, Warden of the Sacred Roots. The trees here have kept the treasures of our people for a thousand years.
greeting.returning: The roots remember you. Welcome back.
greeting.native_race: Elani mellon. Your hollow awaits, child of the forest.

about_service.text: The Glade of Safekeeping is blessed by the eldest trees of this enclave. They store belongings within their hollow roots, keeping them safe from fire, rot, and thieves. Those born under the green canopy may use this gift freely. Others must offer a binding to attune a new hollow to their essence.

ask_about_offering.text: We take no coin here. The grove does not eat gold. Bring instead an offering the roots will recognise: a sprig of mistletoe, a measure of sap, and gathered pollen. Give these to the grove and it will know your scent, and open for you.

pay_offering.text: The roots take your offering... and hold. It is done. Understand what you have joined: the glade does not keep your goods here, in this soil. Every warden's grove draws from the same hollow beneath the world. Leave a thing with me and a keeper in the far mountains will hand it back to you.
pay_offering.success: The grove accepted your offering. You may store items here.
pay_offering.failure: The roots want mistletoe, sap and pollen. Return when you have gathered them.

use_storage.text: Place your hand upon the bark. The tree will open for you. Do not be troubled that the hollow seems deeper than the trunk — it is. Every warden's grove reaches the same hollow beneath the world. What you leave in these roots, you may draw from any keeper's keeping.

maybe_later.text: The forest is patient. We will be here when you are ready.

goodbye.text: May the canopy shelter you, and may your path be ever green.

claim_birthright.text: You were born under the green canopy. The roots know your scent already — they have known it since your first season. No offering is asked of you. Place your hand, child of the forest.
claim_birthright.success: The grove opened for you; the roots knew you already.
claim_birthright.failure: There seems to be some irregularity. Speak with me again.

homeward_stone.text: The Homeward Stones are seeds of the heartwood, cut from the same root that wakes the waystones. Every child of Verdant is given one, and its pull leads back to the glade. Strangers may carry one only if the roots know them. Help us tend what is ours and I will sing one to you.

homeward_gift.text: Then the heartwood has kept it for you. Take it, child of the glade. One is given; a second must be paid for, for the root grows slowly.

homeward_shop.text: Each seed-stone is attuned to Verdant's waystone. The roots ask an offering for every one.
